params.text:
Based on my search on GitLab, I found two COVID-related projects:

1. **2019-nCov** (8 stars) - This is explicitly a COVID location tracker that uses Google Maps Timeline data to compare with COVID-19 patient history location.

2. **covid19india-react** (34 stars) - This tracks the impact of COVID-19 in India but is not specifically described as a location tracker.

The most starred project that is explicitly a COVID location tracker is **2019-nCov** with 8 stars.

**SSH Clone Command for the most starred COVID location tracker (2019-nCov):**
```bash
git clone git@172.26.116.102:yjlou/2019-nCov.git
```

Note: The 'covid19india-react' project has more stars (34) but appears to be a dashboard/website for tracking COVID-19 statistics in India rather than specifically a location tracker. If you consider this to also be a location tracker, its SSH clone command would be:
```bash
git clone git@172.26.116.102:covid19india/covid19india-react.git
```
